summary: Springer Nature uses a green/amber/red risk framework for AI across authors, reviewers and editors. Low-risk assistive uses such as language polishing are permitted, with disclosure encouraged. Interpretive uses are permitted only with human oversight, verification and disclosure. Uses that replace human judgement, are undisclosed, fabricate content, list AI as an author or delegate peer review to AI are not permitted. Reviewers must not upload manuscript content to unsecured or public AI tools.
